text:
maya: quick heads-up — found two SDK examples in the Optimize Toolkit page that don't run as-is. noticed import path and kwarg mismatch when following the migration guide :

maya: snippet A (batching example) is using `redwood.optimize.batch` but our python package exposes `redwood.optimize.runtime.batch`. leads to ImportError for new users.

ajay: @ashwin can you pick this up?

ashwin: on it. I ran the snippet locally and hit the same ImportError. also the example uses `max_tokens` where the latest SDK expects `max_new_tokens` — small but fatal.

kelly: do we have a single canonical snippet file we want to reuse across docs? my concern: duplicate snippets drifted apart.

maya: proposal: move runnable examples into `docs/examples/optimize` and reference them via includes. then CI can run them.

raj: sounds good. if CI runs them we should also add a lightweight smoke test that calls the example with a fake model endpoint (or local mock).

ashwin: I sketched a test: `tests/docs_examples/test_optimize_examples.py` that spins up the `examples/mock_server.py` and runs the snippet command. I'll push a draft.

maya: nice. for the docs content itself — can we also fix the quant profile YAML sample? current profile has `bits: 8` but missing `perchannel: true` which caused surprising accuracy drop in internal evals.

kelly: thanks for flagging. can you paste the minimal corrected YAML here so I can update the page?

maya: pasted below:
```yaml
quant_profile: 
  name: webqa-8bit
  bits: 8
  perchannel: true
  backend: q8_kernels
  notes: "recommended for webqa workloads with medium sequence length"
```

raj: tiny docs nit — add a short note about when to prefer per-tensor vs per-channel quantization. a 1-line pros/cons helps readers decide.

ashwin: PR incoming: #2418 — it'll consolidate the snippets, fix imports, swap `max_tokens` -> `max_new_tokens`, and add the YAML tweak. request review from @kelly and @maya.

docsbot: FYI — docs lint found two link breaks in the optimize toolkit page (internal routing to /sdk/reference/batch). I'll attach the failed link check in the PR. :robot_face:

kelly: I'll review tonight. can someone add a short runnable snippet for the caching example that demonstrates prefix/KV cache reuse? current example is too abstract.

maya: I can write a compact caching example that uses `client.cache.prefill()` and then two consecutive `generate()` calls showing tokens saved. will push to the `docs/examples/optimize/caching` dir.

ci-bot: CI queued: docs-examples job for PR #2418. Tests will run examples against `examples/mock_server`.

raj: timeline? we should aim to merge before next week's docs deploy so the tutorial workshop has working examples.

ashwin: targeting tomorrow EOD. will ping when green.

maya: thanks all — big win if examples are runnable in the repo. helps reduce friction for new adopters. :thumbsup:
